name: tailzu-desktop
description: X0 Bot desktop voice dictation — hotkey → record → clean → paste. Reuses the X0 Bot backend.
author: X0 Bot <hello@x0bot.com>

scripts.audiotap: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13 -o build/audiotap-arm64 audiotap/main.swift && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos13 -o build/audiotap-x64 audiotap/main.swift && lipo -create -output build/audiotap build/audiotap-arm64 build/audiotap-x64 && rm build/audiotap-arm64 build/audiotap-x64
scripts.tzocr: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13 -o build/tzocr-arm64 native/tzocr.swift && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos13 -o build/tzocr-x64 native/tzocr.swift && lipo -create -output build/tzocr build/tzocr-arm64 build/tzocr-x64 && rm build/tzocr-arm64 build/tzocr-x64
scripts.tzax: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13 -o build/tzax-arm64 native/tzax.swift && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos13 -o build/tzax-x64 native/tzax.swift && lipo -create -output build/tzax build/tzax-arm64 build/tzax-x64 && rm build/tzax-arm64 build/tzax-x64
scripts.tzkey: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13 -o build/tzkey-arm64 native/tzkey.swift && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos13 -o build/tzkey-x64 native/tzkey.swift && lipo -create -output build/tzkey build/tzkey-arm64 build/tzkey-x64 && rm build/tzkey-arm64 build/tzkey-x64

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: X0 Bot records your voice to transcribe and clean it into text.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: X0 Bot hears your computer's sound while you take notes, so a call's other voices are in the notes.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: X0 Bot pastes what you said into the app you are typing in.
